info.title: Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.CatalogUpload
info.description: Uploads artifacts to the Skyline DataMiner catalog (https://catalog.dataminer.services)

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Uploads artifacts or their registration info to the artifact storage for the DataMiner Catalog and Cloud Connected Systems. (The default upload has no additional registration and no visibility on the catalog. Use the returned Artifact ID for deployment or download.)

options.name: --path-to-artifact
options.description: Path to the application package (.dmapp), protocol package (.dmprotocol) or test package (.dmtest).

options.name: --dm-catalog-token
options.description: The key to upload to the catalog as defined in admin.dataminer.services. Important! For Volatile Uploads this should be the DataMiner System Token. For Registration Uploads this should be the Organization Token. This is optional if the key can also be provided using the 'DATAMINER_CATALOG_TOKEN' environment variable (unix/win) or using 'DATAMINER_CATALOG_TOKEN_ENCRYPTED' configured with Skyline.DataMiner.CICD.Tools.WinEncryptedKeys (windows).

options.name: --debug
options.description: Indicates the tool should write out debug logging.

commands.name: update-catalog-details
commands.description: Uploads only the registration information for a Skyline DataMiner catalog (https://catalog.dataminer.services) item.

options.name: --path-to-catalog-yml
options.description: Path to a yml file containing catalog details as described here https://docs.dataminer.services/user-guide/Cloud_Platform/Catalog/Register_Catalog_Item.html#manifest-file

options.name: --path-to-readme
options.description: Path to a readme file written in markdown.

options.name: --path-to-images
options.description: Path to a folder with images used in the readme file.

commands.name: with-registration
commands.description: Uploads artifacts to become visible in the Skyline DataMiner catalog (https://catalog.dataminer.services

options.name: --path-to-artifact
options.description: Path to the application package (.dmapp), protocol package (.dmprotocol) or test package (.dmtest).

options.name: --uri-sourcecode
options.description: A Uri for the globally unique location of your sourcecode (not your local workspace). This can be used as a backup to find your artifact. e.g. https://github.com/SkylineCommunications/MyTestRepo

options.name: --artifact-version
options.description: Optional but recommended, include a different version than the internal package version to register your package under (this can be a pre-release version). e.g. '1.0.1', '1.0.1-prerelease1', '1.0.0.1'

options.name: --branch
options.description: Specifies what branch does this version of your package belong to, e.g. 'main', '1.0.0.X', '1.0.X', 'dev/somefeature', etc. Defaults to 'main' when not provided.

options.name: --author-mail
options.description: Optionally include the e-mail of the uploader.

options.name: --release-notes
options.description: Optionally include a URL to the release notes. e.g. https://github.com/SkylineCommunications/MyTestRepo/releases/tag/1.0.3

options.name: --catalog-identifier
options.description: The GUID identifying the catalog item on https://catalog.dataminer.services/. When not provided, this should be present through a catalog.yml file as described here https://docs.dataminer.services/user-guide/Cloud_Platform/Catalog/Register_Catalog_Item.html#manifest-file.

options.name: --path-to-catalog-yml
options.description: Path to a yml file containing catalog details as described here https://docs.dataminer.services/user-guide/Cloud_Platform/Catalog/Register_Catalog_Item.html#manifest-file

options.name: --path-to-readme
options.description: Path to a readme file written in markdown.

options.name: --path-to-images
options.description: Path to a folder with images used in the readme file.
